name: Databases
description: Your Postgres, MySQL, SQLite and SQL Server databases in one place, read-only: browse tables, run queries with a history, and see the schema as a class diagram with keys, relations and their cardinality (join tables and relations without a foreign key found for you, Mermaid, PlantUML and SVG export). Paste a URL or a SQL Server connection string. Agents query and describe them by name without ever seeing the credentials.
author: winfer
